visualReview.notes: All nine final portable frames inspected. Catalog preview now frames C02 and nearby central dishes; dedicated front and rear views show the 45 m parabolic reflector, open mesh, concentric/radial ribs, four focal-feed struts, fork and splayed tower. Whole-array turntables and whole-array QA views necessarily resolve the 25 km dispersed stations as tiny/subpixel marks, so they do not establish fine-detail fidelity; local cameras establish antenna appearance and numeric station probes establish complete scope. Source and runtime master embed the existing canonical procedural mesh fallback, without any photographic texture.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All nine current shared-material frames inspected. Canonical mesh coverage leaves the bowl visibly open; rear braces remain visible through it. Pale painted steel, darker mounts and concrete feet bind four canonical materials. Target-only mode excludes unrelated catalog assets. Opt-in adaptive clipping handles both perspective and north-up orthographic full-array cameras. Unload check passed. Flat fixture is not evidence of host-terrain contact.

mediumFiReview.notes: All 21 final medium-fi frames inspected: noon/late, economy/high, skyline/district/street/closeup and transitions. Local context scale provides useful C02 detail while explicit 84 km far plane retains the remote stations. Original station positions remain fixed through every authored LOD (840/3960/11400/43380 triangles). Thin bars/mesh filter toward fractional pale coverage at distant LODs; closeup visibly retains open rear framework. Synthetic neighbor houses are review context only and are excluded from the asset. No normal, clipping or missing-material failures in detail views.

geographicReview.notes: Complete 30-station operator array, 14 central and 16 outlying, at relative 3D coordinates from the 2025-12-15 GMRT specs Table 3. Native C02 OSM node5773281557 anchors [74.0504627,19.093107], heading0 east/south; independent native central stations cross-check within about4 m. Primary relative up values -33.301868..48.772178 m and independent 30 km terrain remain unchanged. Map circles are explicitly estimated 45 m reflector envelopes, not native building polygons. North-up full-array marks are too small for individual visual alignment; exact numeric positions are probed. Local cartographic curvature/projection offsets and raw terrain cannot certify actual outer-station ground contact. Preview only, replaceFootprint=false.

fidelityReview.notes: Recognizable complete GMRT array, using the exact published Sankashid PD original and owner numeric dimensions/layout. Geometry probes pass1456 checks across four LODs for all30 dishes, parabola profiles/45m spans, focal feed positions, feet and absence of a site ground slab. Source, runtime master and all4 LODs also pass embedded canonical alpha-texture and shared-binding checks. Representative static60 degree southward pointing, mount/fork/rear sections, fine wire census and equipment are bounded estimates. The canonical85mm mesh repeat is coarser than the actual10/15/20mm mesh; no engineering or current operating-state claim.

imageryReview.notes: Started with already-cleared published Qualla media. Individually inspected the exact640x480 GMRT.jpg by Sankashid at en.wikipedia; local bytes match native original SHA1 and the explicit named PD-user/own mobile-photo grant. The filename is distinct from attribution-licensed Gmrt.JPG; corrected case-sensitive family selection is covered by focused tests. All attribution architecture photos, NASA celestial images and other unrelated material are unused. No downloaded mesh, photographic texture or AI image used; canonical material fallback is generated by the existing procedural graph baker.
